PlayStation 5 console 4.5 4.5 out of 5 stars (715)
Siddhesh
5 out of 5 stars
One of the Best Consoles from Sony. If you can get your your hands on one!!!
Reviewed in India on 9 February 2021
Verified Purchase

First of all let me tell you Amazon delivered this a whole week late from launch date, while other retailers delivered theirs on launch day or a day later.

Pros:

1. Design: The design of the consoles is quite unique and way different from previous Sony consoles. Sony did a complete redesign of the console to make it into a dual tone finish of white and black, same with the controller. There are two variants a regular PS5 with a disc and a Digital Edition without a disc drive. The console has a beautiful LED strip around the black front and in the dark it looks absolutely futuristic. The design is honestly subjective you either love it or don't. Personally, the design has grown on me.

2. Dualsense Controller: Sony has completely reworked their controller with the Dualsense. It is now bigger than the DS4 from the PS4. Sony has added Haptic feedback and Adaptive triggers to the Dualsense which is an absolute game changer. In games like Astro's Playroom COD Cold War, Miles Morales, DMC 5, you feel the difference from the previous controller. The adaptive triggers are programmed to give you the feel of individual gun fire or what tension of a web sling or stretching a spring in Astro's Playroom. This is the kind of immersion that we didn't knew we wanted. You might enjoy this features in a slow paced game but, in Multiplayer you can completely turn these features off.

3. Games: Sony launched with two exclusives which were Demon's Souls and Spider-Man: Miles Morales. I have them both and both are fantastic games. For PS plus subscribers, Sony gives you 20 games you can choose to download for free. this includes blockbusters like God of War, Uncharted 4, Persona 5, Days Gone, Battlefield 1, Final Fantasy XV, Detroit and many more to get you started on your Playstation journey. Most of the PS4 games work on the PS5 apart for a a few 3-4 games.

4. Performance: The PS5 performance is really good and a much bigger improvement than the PS4. Sony has also made sure that the Console runs quiet and cool. Sony is also pushing their older games to utilise the increased power of the PS5 by releasing patches for multiple games. Even though the PS5 is little less powerful than the Xbox Series X still the difference in experience is negligible and I would say it would be nitpicky of people to even say that 5-10fps are less than the Xbox.

5. Load Speeds: The new generation of consoles has finally adopted the SSDs and are completely changing the loading times which used to be long minutes of waiting. Games like Miles Morales, Ghost of Tsushima, Days Gone, Astros Playroom and many more take the advantage and load games in an instant. Gone are the days of waiting and waiting to start the game or when you die and to start again.

Cons:

1. Storage: This is one of the major cons the PS5 has. It comes with a 825GB SSD out of which only 667GB is usable storage for games. This is a major problem if you have a lot of games and love playing them constantly. You can move your PS4 games to an external HDD. But this only works for the PS4 games not PS5 games. Sony has also not enabled the NVME SSD expansion slot, so you cannot expand the storage as of now which is a bummer.

2. Disc Drive Noise & Coil Whine issues: The Playstation 5 that has launched in India right now is only the standard one which comes with a disc drive. There are a few people that I've spoken to that have a serious issue of disc spin noise. Personally I don't have this issue, but this is concerning for those unlucky few. As for the coil whine, it's completely normal for the Console to have a little bit of Coil whine. Sony has addressed this is not an issue.

3. Software: The software that now runs on the PS5 has been completely redesigned by Sony. It looks and feels good, but it's not polished as it should be. Sony will be working on these Software issues as the months go by. There is also a lot of useless features included, which I personally don't like but it is completely subjective.

So that's my review for the PS5. If you were able to preorder one you are one of the lucky few. If not please keep trying because this is one of the best Playstion in both looks, Performance and features.

It has been an absolute disaster to get your hands around the PS5, but all said and done this wild goose chase was worth it. An amazing looking console. It looks futuristic and sleek, far better than the "wooden" look of the PS4. The controller is solid and truly next gen with its adaptive triggers and haptic feedback mechanisms. The games pretty obviously look mind blowing specially on my 75 LG 4k OLED. The console is fast and snappy and there's practically no load times or lag anywhere, be it a game or the menu. The PS5 is really an improvement over the PS4 in every possible way. If there was however a minor gripe that I do have, that's the fact that the launch lineup isn't as good as it was on the PS4 but that's easily sorted with all the great games launching throughout this year and beyond. All in all, totally worth the money (and the run around!).

I've always wanted to be a gamer and this is the first thing related to gaming that I've had and I am so, so happy. This thing is well worth the price with the performance it gives you! (Ghost Of Tsushima ran at a constant 60FPS on 4K and the thing barely made a noise!!)

It wasn't easy getting this thing but it felt so, so rewarding when I finally did.

The only complaint I have is that a lot of AAA games like Red Dead Redemption II and some others are locked in 30FPS by the publisher when the PS5 can easily run these games at 60FPS! (This isn't necessarily Sony's fault but it's the only downside I can think of because right now I'm only buying AAA games)

other than that this thing is truly next gen. The Dualsense controller is 100x more advanced than the Dualshock 4 and I was BLOWN AWAY.

Well worth the money

Extremely happy with this ♥️

P.S. if you were to build a PC of the same capabilities as the PS5 then you would easily have to pay above 1,00,000 Rupees or $1,000
